name: Almonds
description: Crisp dry-roasted almonds with golden skin and sweet toasted finish.

name: Cashews
description: Velvety ivory jumbo crescents with opulent, buttery-sweet density.

name: Walnuts
description: Hand-cracked amber-gold halves, silky tender with zero bitterness.

name: Pistachios
description: Naturally tree-opened shells with vivid jade green kernels and sea salt.

name: Raisins
description: Plump sun-dried raisins bursting with natural nectar and honeyed chew.

name: Dates
description: Mammoth dates with molten caramel sweetness and papery thin skins.

name: Figs
description: Golden sun-dried figs with delicate seeds and rich wildflower honey tones.

name: Apricots
description: Plump orange apricots offering a balanced sweet and tart orchard fruitiness.

name: Hazelnuts
description: Slow drum-roasted spherical hazelnuts with fragrant cocoa-praline finish.

name: Macadamia Nuts
description: Opulent round whole macadamias with rich creamy crunch and delicate oils.

name: Brazil Nuts
description: Large distinctive kernels packed with natural selenium and buttery snap.

name: Pecans
description: Deep golden ribbed halves with mellow maple sweetness and tender snap.

name: Pine Nuts
description: Small ivory pine kernels with woodsy resinous aroma and tender sweetness.
